scientific_integrity: The proof is analytic and does not use computational enumeration to justify infinite quantifiers. The status describes self-review only, not external validation.
scientific_limitations: Only \(k\ge3\) facilities, \(n=k+1\) distinct locations, nearest-facility utilitarian social cost, and this specific random subset mechanism. Global novelty cannot be certified by a finite literature search; the \(k=2\) special case is already established. No strategyproofness claimed for \(k\ge4\).
title: Sharp small-population bounds for the Product-Gap facility mechanism
